homepage_update_plan.add is empty: every memory-backed requested field is already rendered in the snapshot, either in _pages/about.md, in the _config.yml author card, or in both.

homepage_update_plan.replace is empty: no memory-backed requested field carries a homepage value that contradicts memory. The only divergences are presentational - capitalisation of the three research interests, month names spelled out in 'Research Experience' ('February 2025 - Present' vs 'Feb 2025 - Present'), the '@' prefix that the profile-card twitter key drops, and the profile-card bio being a differently worded condensation of the same memory-backed facts. Each is recorded in the matching leave_unchanged entry via 'match' and 'note'.

awards and portrait_url are the two requested fields the homepage renders without memory support, so they stay in omitted_fields while their homepage traces are listed under remove_or_do_not_copy. phone, service and teaching are absent from memory and from the rendered homepage alike, so they need no homepage action.

remove_or_do_not_copy also covers homepage content that is not a requested field ('Skills' section; profile-card location 'Hong Kong') and per-entry embellishments memory does not record (internship advisor names Zifei Shan and Prof. Yu Cheng; publication venues, author lists and '[Code]' links). Their parent fields publications and research_experience remain memory-backed and are left unchanged - only those sub-details must not be propagated as memory-backed content.

Memory additionally holds long_bio, github_url and twitter_url. They are not listed in requested_homepage_fields.json, so they are not reported as usable_fields; long_bio is cited as evidence for short_bio (the homepage intro paragraph reproduces it verbatim) and the two URLs corroborate the github and twitter handles.
